description: Get the latest air-quality readings (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, SO2, CO, etc.) at the monitoring station NEAREST to a latitude/longitude. PREFER for "air quality near me", "what is the air quality at <coordinates>", "is the air bad in <place> right now". Returns the nearest station with its most recent pollutant values, plus other nearby stations.

_apiKey.description: OpenAQ API key (optional; the gateway supplies one).

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (default 12, max 25 — OpenAQ limit).

name: air_quality_near
title: Air Quality Near
